what: Behind the page, a fixed full-screen canvas ripples with aurora curtains — two noise layers (horizontal 1.6x and 3.1x, time .06·.14·.11·.05) shake the height of the curtain’s bottom edge and it brightens toward the top (center .2, blur .5), while colors change as a band of four accent colors flows horizontally at .04 per second. Drawn at half screen resolution with a 40% background-color veil on top so text stays readable. With reduced motion or a hidden tab, only one frame is drawn

options.mid: Midpoint value as the light fills in, default .2 — raise it and the curtain retreats upward
options.flow: Speed of the color band flow (per sec), default .04
options.res: Render resolution scale (relative to 1 device pixel or less), default .5
options.look: With local, it is laid only inside this element rather than fixed to the screen
options.--fx-aurora-1 ~ 4: Four color-band stops (0·33.6·50·100%) (via style) — the default soft accent tint turned toward pink → --kf-accent-soft → --kf-accent → --kf-accent as a deep purple

note: WebGL 1. The canvas and veil are fixed at z-index -1, so if the body creates its own stacking context (a panel filled with a background color) it hides behind that panel — make panels semi-transparent or transparent

from.where: shared.js body[data-fx=aurora-veil] — original body[data-brand-aurora]’s aurora-gl (--ds-aurora-stops pink → purple → indigo → magenta)
